semantics: An optional unresolved fact remains explicit, is counted in the review packet and cannot be silently rewritten. Not-reported/not-applicable remain source-scope assessments requiring independent human acceptance. Empty groups require review; schema validity alone does not attest completeness. Framework non-applicability requires a source-grounded analyst rationale and human acceptance, not a forced class.
group_assessment_semantics: Every empty governed group requires its own exact-head human missingness assessment: not_reported or not_applicable after full-text examination. Engineering packets leave these null; true, recorded, missing or uncertain are invalid for an empty group. Non-empty groups are recorded. The version-bound checklist digest is retained in the immutable receipt.
